stem: A resident pharmacy will close in three weeks. Which actions are required to protect patients? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Identify patients who received prescriptions during the preceding 90 days.
Destroy patient files on the closure date.
Attempt patient notice at least 14 days before closure and post a conspicuous notice.
Process requested file transfers promptly enough to avoid interrupting therapy.
Notify only patients who received controlled substances.

explanation.core_reasoning: The supported conclusions on these facts are: Identify patients who received prescriptions during the preceding 90 days. Attempt patient notice at least 14 days before closure and post a conspicuous notice. Process requested file transfers promptly enough to avoid interrupting therapy.

choice_analysis.A: Supported: Identify patients who received prescriptions during the preceding 90 days.
choice_analysis.B: Not supported: Destroy patient files on the closure date.
choice_analysis.C: Supported: Attempt patient notice at least 14 days before closure and post a conspicuous notice.
choice_analysis.D: Supported: Process requested file transfers promptly enough to avoid interrupting therapy.
choice_analysis.E: Not supported: Notify only patients who received controlled substances.

related_facts: A closing pharmacy identifies patients served in the preceding 90 days, attempts notice at least 14 days before closure, posts conspicuous notice, and supports timely patient-file transfer.
explanation.mpje_trap: Distinguish this near-miss from the controlling rule: 'Destroy patient files on the closure date.'

reasoning_steps: Match the scenario's operative facts to Patient notice before pharmacy closure
